start.text: The shift is over. The fakes had one thing in common: a domain that only looked like ours.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. The lesson is the same every time: check the sender, teach the staff, and ask for a second proof.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Some of the new cards [b][color=green]Reflect[/color][/b]. Point at the word to read it. Every hit that lands on you is sent back.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So a hit on me hurts the threat too. And I buy the upgrade my clues point at.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. Check the sender, train the staff, and hold a key that is not a password.
E.name: Joshua
